def make_group_labels(df, group_col, donor_col="patient_id"):
    """Build x-tick labels annotated with nucleus (n) and donor counts per group,
    e.g. "True\n(n=33 nuclei, 3 donors)". Keyed by the string form of each group value
    so it can be looked up from ax.get_xticklabels().
    """
    counts_n = df[group_col].value_counts()
    counts_donor = df.groupby(group_col, observed=True)[donor_col].nunique()
    return {
        str(g): f"{g}\n(n={counts_n[g]:,} nuclei,\n{counts_donor[g]} donors)"
        for g in counts_n.index
    }

def annotate_group_labels(ax, df, group_col, donor_col="patient_id"):
    """Relabel the x-tick labels of a categorical plot (violin/box) with n nuclei + n donors per group."""
    labels = make_group_labels(df, group_col, donor_col)
    ax.set_xticks(ax.get_xticks())
    ax.set_xticklabels([labels[t.get_text()] for t in ax.get_xticklabels()], fontsize=7)
    return ax

df = adata.obs.dropna(subset=["Schwann_genes", "lesion_type", "patient_id","sex","pmi_hrs"]).copy()

# Fit linear mixed model: Schwann_genes ~ condition + (1 | patient)
df["lesion_type"] = df["lesion_type"].cat.reorder_categories(
    ["Ctrl"] + [c for c in df["lesion_type"].cat.categories if c != "Ctrl"],
    ordered=True
)

md = smf.mixedlm("Schwann_genes ~ lesion_type + sex + pmi_hrs", data=df, groups=df["patient_id"])
mdf = md.fit(reml=False)  # REML often used for variance components
print(mdf.summary())

df = adata.obs.dropna(subset=["Schwann_genes", "condition", "patient_id","sex","pmi_hrs"]).copy()

# Ensure categorical types
df["condition"] = df["condition"].astype("category")
df["patient_id"] = df["patient_id"].astype("category")

# Fit linear mixed model: Schwann_genes ~ condition + (1 | patient)
md = smf.mixedlm("Schwann_genes ~ condition + sex + pmi_hrs", data=df, groups=df["patient_id"])
mdf = md.fit(reml=True)  # REML often used for variance components
print(mdf.summary())
